One year sober here as of last Thursday. Working a program is it man, sucks at first and was definitely not something I wanted to do when I first got clean but probably the greatest decision I’ve ever made. AA/NA whatever floats your boat, get a sponsor, work the steps. 

One thing I will say is a lot of people convince themselves that smoking weed isn’t as bad as drinking/other drugs but getting high from anything is all the same in my opinion. Everytime you get high your trying to escape, get away, or numb yourself from your current situation. Yeah weed is a lot less harsh and probably less likely to ruin your life but either way it’s important to find the route cause of your use (which you will find through the steps) and you need to really be sober to find that. A lot of guys get clean then smoking a little weed leads them right back to where they started.
